# Reviewed package

Place `wmsxwd1-1.42.3-Linux.deb` in this directory before building. The file is
intentionally ignored by Git and must have this SHA-256:

```text
91c1b6f8eab810858fd5997d18de3790784ed6a3ca8400413c05e439c10d5b85
```

The Docker build verifies the digest before extracting any package content.
